ThingDef.label: suppressive incendiary high-velocity light machine gun round

AbilityDef.label: radar scan pulse
AbilityDef.description: Mark a target with a focused radar pulse. The primary target is locked for follow-up fire, suffers sensor disruption and EMP interference, and hostile pawns around it are exposed so they lose invisibility and can no longer rely on blind smoke for protection.

HediffDef.label: radar lock
HediffDef.description: This pawn has been pinned by an active targeting solution. Its outline and motion are easier to track through smoke and confusion, making coordinated fire more accurate and more punishing.

HediffDef.label: radar exposed
HediffDef.description: This pawn has been painted by a radar sweep. It cannot depend on concealment effects for long, and any active invisibility is repeatedly disrupted while the exposure lasts.

HediffDef.label: wire-guiding missile
HediffDef.description: This pawn is holding an anti-armor missile on a command line. Any movement would break the guidance solution before the missile reaches its mark or misses near it.

HediffDef.label: suppressed
HediffDef.description: This pawn is under concentrated suppressive fire. Repeated impacts force it lower, blur its sight picture, and ruin any attempt to move or shoot with confidence.

HediffDef.label: neuroshock
HediffDef.description: An active-matter neuroshock burning along the nervous system. Motor control fails first, so the victim drags and staggers, then awareness dulls until the body simply gives out and drops. It bleeds off gradually once the hits stop landing, and a target that was pressed all the way down takes far longer to get back on its feet.

AbilityDef.label: underbarrel burner
AbilityDef.description: Discharge the rifle's compact burner unit to wash a short cone in burning fuel. The burst splashes flammable liquid across the target area and immediately ignites it, making it excellent for forcing fires onto the ground and flushing enemies out of cover.

AbilityDef.label: launch signal flare
AbilityDef.description: Launch an active-matter signal flare. On landing it floods the area with harsh light, disrupts hidden targets, and splashes the nearby ground with ignited fuel in a single incendiary burst.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya police revolver
ThingDef.description: A short-barreled police revolver kept as a last-ditch defensive sidearm. It is compact and dependable at arm's length, but the stubby barrel and crude sights make it inaccurate outside close self-defense range.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya bolt-action rifle
ThingDef.description: A long-pattern bolt-action rifle tuned for deliberate aimed fire. Its action is slow and the weapon is cumbersome, but it reaches far and punches above the industrial norm.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya assault rifle
ThingDef.description: A full-length assault rifle built to Rukaya standards. It is heavier and slower to recover between bursts than human rifles, but it keeps tight groupings and strong terminal performance at longer range.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya marksman rifle
ThingDef.description:
A self-loading marksman rifle built for disciplined aimed fire at mid-to-long range. It gives up some extreme reach compared to a dedicated sniper rifle, but cycles faster and keeps strong precision with a full-power cartridge.
Active matter mode fires incendiary marksman rifle rounds.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya service pistol
ThingDef.description:
A standardized self-loading pistol issued to regular Rukaya troops. It is a clear step above emergency sidearms in handling and sustained fire, but it still remains a sidearm meant for disciplined close combat rather than long-range marksmanship.
Fed active matter, the weapon overdrives every round: each shot strikes harder with tighter aim, and the whole firing cycle runs faster and reaches further while the charge lasts. Overcharged rounds also carry a neuroshock payload, so every landed hit drags the victim's movement down and dulls its awareness. Scattered hits only slow a target; it takes sustained fire on one enemy to put it on the ground, and the harder it was pressed, the longer it stays there. The pistol is built to take enemies alive rather than to simply kill them.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya grenade pistol
ThingDef.description:
A compact launcher built around a pistol-sized grip and a short grenade tube. It gives ordinary infantry a controllable explosive sidearm, trading blast radius and reach for portability and quick handling.
Active matter mode loads incendiary canisters that splash fuel across the impact area and ignite it without the signal flare's anti-invisibility pulse.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya submachine gun
ThingDef.description:
A compact automatic firearm for boarding actions, corridor fighting, and mobile assaults. It is easy to bring onto target and pours rounds out quickly, but its small cartridge and short barrel make it fade fast outside close-range combat.
Fed active matter, the gun overdrives both cartridge and action: heavier hits, tighter aim, a faster firing cycle, and longer reach while the charge lasts. Overcharged rounds also carry a neuroshock payload. Because the gun fires in bursts the shock piles up quickly, but it also bleeds off quickly: one landed burst leaves a target barely able to move, and a second one pressed straight after it is what actually puts the target on the ground. The longer an enemy is kept under this fire, the longer it stays down. The submachine gun is built to take enemies alive rather than to simply kill them.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya light machine gun
ThingDef.description:
A squad support light machine gun tuned for long bursts rather than elegance. It is heavy, loud, and clumsy in the hands, but its sustained suppressive fire is valuable whenever a Rukaya line unit needs to pin enemies in place.
Active matter mode loads suppressive incendiary rounds. Each hit has a chance to ignite the target, and the impact zone showers nearby hostiles in suppressive shock that drags down movement, shooting accuracy, and sight until the pressure finally lifts.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya aviation machine gun
ThingDef.description: An aviation-pattern rotary machine gun built around the same full-power ammunition as the Rukaya light machine gun. Its electrically driven barrel cluster launches those rounds at higher velocity and cycles through a long burst with brutal consistency, but its conventional feed can jam under sustained fire, cutting the burst short and forcing a lengthy clearing cycle. The weapon is also heavy and difficult to handle. An oversized active matter reservoir keeps its powered firing system supplied through sustained fire. Active matter mode loads suppressive incendiary rounds and stabilizes the feed, preventing jams.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya grenade launcher
ThingDef.description:
A grenade launcher built for line infantry support. It is too slow and specialized to replace a rifle, but it gives regular troops reliable explosive reach against cover, light emplacements, and clustered hostiles.
Active matter mode loads arc shock grenades that search farther than the blast itself, strike up to ten hostile pawns around the impact point, and lash each victim with flame burn damage and a strong EMP discharge.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya recoilless gun
ThingDef.description:
An engineer's improvisation elevated into a field weapon: someone looked at a fixed recoilless cannon, decided it would be faster to unbolt it and carry it by hand, and then actually made it work. The result hits brutally hard, but the sheer mass drags its operator down and makes quick target acquisition miserable.
Its standard shell is a single armor-piercing round that concentrates all force into one target. Active matter mode loads an overcharged shell that strikes even harder, penetrates deeper, and detonates on impact to catch nearby enemies in the blast.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya assault rifle (grenade)
ThingDef.description: A standard assault rifle fitted with an underslung signal-flare projector. It keeps the ordinary rifle's practical role while giving its user a limited support tool for exposing hidden threats, lighting a target area, and splashing an area with ignited fuel in a single burst.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya assault rifle (flamethrower)
ThingDef.description: A modified assault rifle with a compact burner unit integrated under the handguard. It sacrifices some balance and rifle elegance in exchange for a short-ranged burst of burning fuel that can forcibly ignite the ground, making it excellent for siege fighting, room clearing, and flushing defenders out of cover.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya assault rifle (radar)
ThingDef.description: A command-pattern assault rifle built around an enlarged sensor package and synchronized targeting suite. It takes longer to settle into a shot than a standard rifle, but once it does, it delivers notably tighter fire and can designate a target for the whole squad.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya airburst rocket launcher
ThingDef.description: A rugged triple-tube launcher built for militia fire teams. It throws a slow, inaccurate salvo of compact rockets over cover, trading precision and reload speed for enough blast pressure to break up grouped attackers.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya plasma shotgun
ThingDef.description: A close-assault plasma projector built around a broad dispersal chamber. It hurls a dense wave of superheated particles that tears through soft targets and cover at short range, but the spread falls off quickly once the fight opens up.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya plasma railgun
ThingDef.description:
A precision long gun that magnetically accelerates a plasma-sheathed penetrator. Its firing cycle is deliberate and power-hungry, but each shot reaches deep into armor and stays dangerous far beyond the distances where ordinary rifles begin to fail.
Each shot resolves instantly in a blue-white plasma pulse, leaving a luminous beam that fades along its path and a bright impact flash. Active matter mode increases direct-hit damage and armor penetration.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya laser rifle
ThingDef.description: A line rifle that trades raw projectile mass for tightly collimated thermal pulses. Its beams lose little coherence in ordinary infantry engagement envelopes, making it a dependable mid-range weapon against exposed troops and lightly protected targets.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya smart revolver
ThingDef.description: A high-end sidearm fitted with a compact predictive sighting package. The weapon still fires from a revolver pattern for reliability, but its fire-control assistance makes it unnervingly quick to settle on a target and unusually accurate for something this small. Rounds that connect tend to be guided onto the head, and when fed active matter each shot is overdriven to strike harder with tighter aim, a faster cycle, and longer reach.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya ATGM launcher
ThingDef.description:
A shoulder-launched anti-armor guided missile frame issued to heavy infantry and ambush teams. Its operator must hold the sightline after launch, walking the missile onto the target by command-line guidance. With a clear view and no smoke interference, the missile corrects onto its mark; radar-locked targets are struck with a sharper armor-piercing attack.
Active matter mode loads a charged missile that streaks to its mark at far higher speed. On impact the warhead douses the blast zone in burning fuel and releases an electric surge that chains through every hostile still standing nearby.

ThingDef.label: Rukaya autocannon
ThingDef.description: A man-portable autocannon built for brutal direct support rather than graceful marksmanship. Every burst is expensive, loud, and physically punishing to carry into position, but the weapon answers with heavy shells that shred hard cover and overwhelm anything caught in the open.

HediffDef.label: phantom toxin
HediffDef.description: A creeping toxin delivered by a phantom arrow. It dulls the senses and saps coordination until the body purges it.

AbilityDef.label: launch smoke shell
AbilityDef.description: Launch a smoke shell from the prototype's underbarrel magazine. It releases a standard cloud of blind smoke on impact, blocking turret targeting and reducing incoming fire accuracy.

ThingDef.label: Phantom
ThingDef.description: A slender composite bow whose arrows carry a slow-acting toxin. The Phantom does not throw the heaviest shot, but a single clean hit leaves its mark in the target's blood long after the arrow itself is forgotten.

ThingDef.label: Peacekeeper
ThingDef.description: A massive six-shot revolver built around a full-power rifle cartridge. Its cylinder cycles six rounds in a single hammering string, and every round hits with rifle-grade force. The price is weight, recoil, and a firing cycle that takes a moment to settle.

ThingDef.label: Prototype assault rifle
ThingDef.description: An experimental assault rifle that pairs a conventional Rukaya rifle action with an underbarrel five-round smoke shell magazine. Its primary fire is dependable and familiar, while the auxiliary magazine lets a soldier lay down standard smoke cover without leaving the firing line.
